description.zh: 应用ID。通过控制台创建和查询，仅支持传单个ID。
description.en: The ID of the application. You can create and find the application ID in the console. Only one ID can be specified.

descriptions.zh:
### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
### QPS limits

This API has a QPS limit of 10 queries per second (QPS) per user. If you exceed this limit, rate limiting is triggered, which can affect your business operations. Call the API at a reasonable rate.
